# Project Summary

## Overview
This project is a web application built with Python Flask framework. The main functionality appears to be executing shell commands through a web interface. The application also includes a brand showcase webpage and has dependencies for data processing with pandas and Excel files.

## Main Features
- Web interface built with Flask
- Command execution endpoint (`/exec`) that can run shell commands
- Static brand showcase HTML page with responsive design
- Data processing capabilities using pandas library
- Excel file handling with openpyxl library
- Configurable server settings (port, bind address)

## Important Usage Information
- The application runs on port 5050 by default
- Contains an endpoint (`/exec`) that can execute arbitrary shell commands - this should be secured in production environments
- Requires Python dependencies listed in requirements.txt (pandas, openpyxl)
- Server configuration can be modified in `server_config.py`

## Security Note
The application contains a significant security risk with its command execution endpoint that can run arbitrary shell commands. This should not be deployed in a production environment without proper authentication and input validation.
